import random as rand

def merge(arr1, arr2):
    result = []
    i, j = 0, 0
    while i < len(arr1) and j < len(arr2):
        if arr1[i] <= arr2[j]:
            result.append(arr1[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            result.append(arr2[j])
            j += 1
    result += arr1[i:]
    result += arr2[j:]
    return result

def mergeSort(arr):
    if len(arr) <= 1:
        return arr

    mid = len(arr)//2
    a = mergeSort(arr[:mid])
    b = mergeSort(arr[mid:])
    return merge(a, b)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    arr = [rand.randint(1,100) for _ in range(10)]
    print("previously: ", arr)
    x = mergeSort(arr)
    print("After Sorting: ", x)
    print("Sorted: ", sorted(arr) == x)

import random as rand 

def insertionSort(arr):
    for i in range(1, len(arr)):
        j = i-1
        cval = arr[i]
        while arr[j] > cval and j >= 0:
            arr[j+1] = arr[j]
            j-= 1
        arr[j+1] = cval

if __name__ == "__main__":
    arr = [rand.randint(1,100) for _ in range(10)]
    print("previously: ", arr)
    insertionSort(arr)
    print("After Sorting: ", arr)
